note: Primitive state park campground in Islay Creek canyon at Montaña de Oro, beside the Spooner Ranch House visitor center on Pecho Valley Rd, about 4 mi south of Los Osos. Paved back-in sites; the first loop is a short walk across the park road to Spooner's Cove beach, and the upper sites run about half a mile up the canyon. Water spigots and pit toilets; the nearest showers and dump station are at Morro Bay State Park. --Claude
summary: Islay Creek (Montaña de Oro SP): open (Spooner's Cove closed for high surf 11-26; Coralina Cove closed indefinitely), $25 flat, 47 sites (41 web-bookable), max 27 ft back-in paved, pit toilets + water, no showers/dump/hookups, 10-night max on RC; WATERFRONT UPGRADE candidate not waterfront -> coastal walk (sites ~160-900 m from Spooner's Cove beach, park road only between); phone 805-772-7434 -> (805) 772-6101.
flags: WATERFRONT UPGRADE candidate (not waterfront -> coastal walk; value is --Claude): every RC site is tagged 'Proximity to Water: Walk to Beach'; the campground map puts sites 1-21 beside the Spooner's Ranch House, across Pecho Valley Road (a park road) and the day-use parking from Spooner's Cove; on Esri imagery the lower loop's west end (~35.2741,-120.8866) is ~160 m from the sand beach (~35.2742,-120.8884) and the farthest upper sites (~35.2752,-120.8787) ~0.9 km. No highway, town or rail between, so the coastal-walk rule (easy walk up to about a mile to the ocean shore, the park's own day-use beach and roads allowed between) is met. Not coastal dunes (a day-use complex lies between). Sites are sold nightly.
